content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 denies the claim for missing required prior authorization; the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. The valid coding and correct billing order provide no basis for a corrected resubmission, while the denial permits a formal medical-necessity appeal. That appeal is the available action that can properly pursue payer reimbursement without shifting the denied balance to the patient or escalating unnecessarily.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
